rationale: Status unresolved. Original EO 10582 is held in the official 19 FR 8723-8725 Federal Register issue and all three page images were inspected. The 1989 codification observation says only that it was printed as in force on 1989-01-20; it is not current-status proof. EO 13881 §3 later says EO 10582 is superseded only to the extent inconsistent, and that subsections 2(a) and 2(c) are revoked only upon issuance of its final rule. EO 14005 §14(b) repeats a partial, extent-of-inconsistency supersession. The operative scope of those partial actions and whether the referenced final rule issued are not yet established, so neither whole-order NO nor current YES is supported.
